scope: Production WASM CityEngine.step(1) call timings from a dedicated headless Chromium module worker; excludes the application simulation worker scheduler, renderer, browser frames, and worker message scheduling

measurement.call_scope: Each sample brackets one synchronous JS-to-WASM CityEngine.step(1) call with performance.now(). Save serialization, JSON parsing, snapshot generation, checkpoint inspection, and yields are outside each sample.

observation_limits: Pending-plan, exhausted-face count, and selected-face identity are read from serialized saves every 200 ticks, so face switches between checkpoints may be missed. Construction admission/opening observations come from snapshots every 20 tick(s); interval 1 records the exact observed step, while coarser intervals can miss or delay transitions. An observed open connected road does not prove which planner caused it or that any dependent lots were released. Snapshot probes are outside raw step timings but increase overall run time.
claims: Per-call WASM timing only. These measurements do not predict whole-app tick throughput or browser frame rate.
